descriptions.text: Top ten thievery. $34 million taken from Vee Finance earns them the number 7 spot on our leaderboard, yet nobody seems surprised. What’s normal for us is not normal elsewhere.

On September 21, 2021, Vee Finance was exploited for $34,35 million on Avalanche through price oracle manipulation compounded by a decimal bug in its slippage validation. The attacker manipulated Pangolin DEX prices monitored by the protocol's oracle, bypassing protections and draining ETH and BTC vaults. Two critical flaws enabled the exploit: Vee Finance relied on a single, manipulable DEX price as its oracle, and the slippage check failed to account for discrepancies in decimal representation between assets, allowing the attacker to bypass value checks when the DEX price was manipulated.

The Vee Finance decentralized finance platform was hacked for $35 million worth of Ethereum and Bitcoin. The platform suspended trading after the hack was discovered, and also tried to tempt the hackers with promises of a bug bounty if they'd just be so kind as to return the funds. The platform had only launched a week earlier, though boasted of having $300 million worth of assets locked on their exchange.
